Stopgap Pane.name: Stopgap Pane
Stopgap Pane.description: The user snaps a door-sized panel into being anywhere within a few strides. Set in an attack's path, it takes the blow, blade, thrown object or handgun round meant for the person behind it; slammed into a target instead, it deals force damage and shoves them back a few steps, or, held back, only pushes them away. Strain: light.
